thread:
sara: Heads up — kicking off prod deploy for model-route v2.3.0. Quiet window active 23:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: FF `model-route-v2` ramp 0% -> 20% @ +15m -> 50% @ +45m. I'll enable a manual pin for legacy cohort during this window. Ping if any blockers.

deploy-bot: Pipeline #4723 started -> prod (eu-west). Canary on 1% traffic. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/4723 :rocket:

aj: saw the canary go live — telemetry baseline still warming. Please hold on full shift until we see latency stable for 2 consecutive 5m windows. :eyes:

kevin: quick telemetry check — canary latency +45ms vs baseline (p50). Error rate 0.4% (threshold 0.5%). Not a blocker yet but keep an eye.

maria: adding release note stub: "model-route v2.3.0 — kernel optimizations + quantization profile change." I'll update proper notes after rollout. Also adding guardrail: rollback if error_rate > 1% OR p95 increase > 100ms.

sara: aj — agree, hold ramp until two green windows. Meanwhile I'm manually pinning legacy cohort to 2.2.9 so older sessions aren't impacted. Doing pin now.

deploy-bot: Manual operation: feature-flag pin applied for cohort `legacy` -> model-route v2.2.9. (operator: sara) :white_check_mark:

aj: thanks. Can you paste the exact FF command you used so infra can audit?

sara: used the console UI but equivalent CLI: ```
# pin legacy cohort to old model
ffctl set model-route-v2 --cohort legacy --version 2.2.9 --note "quiet-window manual pin"
```

kevin: noted in telemetry — legacy cohort pinned, canary still 1%. Watching p95 and error %. If p95 stays < +80ms and errors <0.6% for next 10m we can go to 20%.

maria: ops-oncall — tagging you for visibility. If anything breaches the rollback guardrail, we'll execute the rollback command below.

ops-oncall: on it, monitoring dashboards and alerts. Will call out in this thread if thresholds hit.

maria: rollback command (pre-approved):
```
deploy-bot rollback --deployment 4723 --target-version 2.2.9 --reason "rollback guardrail breach"
```
If executed, also run `ffctl set model-route-v2 --all --version 2.2.9` to force cohort parity.

sara: marking this thread as the deploy window log. I'll update release notes with who pinned and why: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REL-4723 — please add QA/ops postmortem if we hit rollback.

aj: ack. keeping watch. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary metrics steady for 2 consecutive 5m windows. Awaiting manual approval to proceed to 20%. (Request by sara)

sara: approving ramp to 20%. Proceed when ready.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 20% initiated. Will report back after 15m.

kevin: seeing small p95 drift (+65ms) but stable; errors unchanged. Continue monitoring.

maria: added final note in the release doc and tagged product. No rollback needed so far.

ops-oncall: all clear from monitoring side for now.

sara: thanks team — leaving the manual pin in place for quiet window. Will unpin after 03:00 UTC and validate full shift metrics in staging before unpin.
